title: Count Square Submatrices with All Ones

examples.explanation: There are ten 1×1 squares, four 2×2 squares, and one 3×3 square: 10 + 4 + 1 = 15.

inputFormat: Implement countSquares(matrix), where matrix is a non-empty rectangular binary grid.
outputFormat: The total number of contiguous square submatrices containing only 1s, counting every position and side length separately.

visuals.title: Different sizes count separately
